svg.title: 店头定价三层示意图
svg.desc: 定价先算成本底线，再对照近期成交价，最后给出店头标价。底线以下不卖；标价应能解释，并准备在滞销或行情变化时改价。
svg.text: 店头定价：底线、成交、标价分三层看
Floor, recent sold, then ask. Do not sell below the floor. Reprice when the card sits or the market moves.
底线 = 进货成本 + 变动费用 + 你要求的最低毛利
Floor = cost + variable fees + minimum margin you need. Below this, a sale hurts break-even.
参照 = 同卡同级的近期成交价（不是在售标价）
Reference = recent sold prices for the same card and grade, not asking prices.
标价 = 在参照附近，并能向客人说明为什么是这个价
Ask price should be explainable. Convenience can support a small premium; a student area will not pay a tourist premium.
